commit.message:
NFC: Always quote ${srcdir} and ${pkgdir}

Just in case someone has space in his path to MINGW-packages repo.
drop more clang32 packages
Add some CPEs
gmp: add macro to let applications link static
gmp: Update to 6.3.0

gmp: Do not declare functions as `dllimport`

GNU toolchains do not require `dllimport` when calling functions from
DLLs. Having `dllimport` by default causes static linking to fail,
observed when building GDB.

Signed-off-by: LIU Hao <lh_mouse@126.com>
gmp: favor shared over static

Make sure every package using a C/C++ compiler depends on one

The "cc" virtual package provides the environment default compiler.

GMP: optimized instructions for all x86 chips

see https://gmplib.org/manual/Build-Options
Makedepend on autotools where needed
Enable clangarm64 for bootstrap packages
Enable clang32 for all packages already in the repo
Enable clang64 for all packages already in the repo
gmp: bump pkgrel
gmp: disable assembly for new arches

gmp: autoreconf to fix libtool for clang/lld

gmp has custom config.guess/config.sub files, so stash them out of the
way and restore them after autoreconf.
More ucrt
gmp: Update to 6.2.1

gmp: remove workaround --default-image-base-low

This was only required until gcc was rebuilt with the fixed import
library from #7052.

Teach gmp asm how to define functions on MINGW.

GMP already knew how do to this on x86, and why, but neglected to apply
the same fix to x86_64.  Fixes #6983.

Rebuild isl, mpc, and mpfr just in case, and gcc to get proper linkage.
